purpose: Close a bounded public-source intake and preserve its missing-input contract while repairing the operational checkpoint. No new model or fit.

frozen_target.model: CLK002-EM-SCALAR-EFT-v1, external hypothetical benchmark, not TECT-derived
frozen_target.time: Imported metric proper time, not PAH Markov time
frozen_target.dimension_domain: 3+1 inserted weak-field exterior; outward radial coordinate; no lattice or UV/volume limit
frozen_target.normalization: z=-c^2*d_r ln(nu_Rb/nu_Cs)/gbar; eta=(a_Ti-a_Pt)/gbar; gbar=(a_Ti+a_Pt)/2 at the same comparison location
frozen_target.scope: Earth is the chosen acquisition target, not an authorization to pool Earth and Sun or change CLK002. Different experimental positions/epochs need a declared transport and source model.

NAVEX1987.locator: Hammesfahr, Systematic Performance of the Space Clocks in the NAVEX Experiment; printed pages 71-78, PDF pages 102-109 (one-based); direct RFS-CFS discussion printed75/PDF106

MICRO2022.locator: PDF4 Eq(1)-(2); PDF20 Table7; PDF26 Table11; section6 Eq(13)-(19); PDF29 data availability

MECM010.locator: Author source distribution; synthetic example, not mission data

solar_clock.conversion: z=b_sun*g_U/gbar, g_U=-d_r U_sun; ratio g_U/gbar is not set to one

earth_clock.quantity: Flight RFS-CFS phase comparison during about 5.5 days
earth_clock.reason: Temperature correction incomplete; baseplate rather than internal temperature, thermal lag and unexplained attitude/orbit residuals. No calibrated radial log-frequency-ratio estimator or joint nuisance covariance in inspected paper.

earth_freefall.reported_quantity: eta(Ti,Pt) approximated by fitted delta against modeled Earth gravity
earth_freefall.exact_conversion: eta=delta/((r_Ti+r_Pt)/2), r_A=m_gA/m_iA; common-mode denominator needs justification

fountain_corrections.scope: Table III then-current values, not a universal correction across all epochs or NAVEX

flight_material.assay_convention: UNRESOLVED_HEADER_VERSUS_SUM; preserve entries, no silent renormalization

instrument_calibration.scope: Published parameter means/std and upper-bound temperature sensitivities do not specify full nuisance covariance

pair_audit.reason: Same named source is necessary, not sufficient: spatial/epoch transport, z extraction, common normalization and errors remain missing

earth_clock_z.need: Time-tagged Rb/Cs frequency-ratio data, position/potential variation, validated estimator, masks, thermal/magnetic/transfer corrections and their uncertainties

freefall_raw_and_mask.need: Public flight product schema, samples, flags, design matrix, noise PSD and calibrated residuals; portal release reported but raw schema not inspected

same_source_transport.need: Earth multipoles, spatial/radial transport, epochs, external-body subtraction and gbar calibration at the declared comparison location

total_material_sensitivities.owner: Atomic/nuclear response and material assay owners
total_material_sensitivities.need: Total K including nuclear-g EM derivative, full unprimed Q_TiAlV,Q_PtRh,Q_Earth with joint uncertainties, isotope convention and mass weights

joint_covariance.need: Clock/freefall nuisance blocks, within-series correlation and cross-probe shared calibration law; zero off-diagonal blocks require justification

finite_response_remainder.need: Uniform bound for scalar nonlinear response, finite-size/multipole effects, denominator calibration and post-Newtonian terms on an explicit coupling/domain range

prospective_holdout.need: New undisclosed batch IDs, exposure timestamps, calibration/validation partition and no post-disclosure retuning

portal.non_inference: Access failure is not evidence of data nonexistence. No credentials bypass or synthetic substitute.

data_roles.retrospective: All sources in this intake are exposed, published evidence. No likelihood or parameter fit is performed.
data_roles.SUREF: Instrument null/control, not automatically Ti/Pt theoretical holdout
data_roles.excluded_substitution: Earth Sr clock processed data cannot replace the frozen co-located Rb/Cs ratio

next_single_question: Can an observation owner supply an Earth-sourced Rb/Cs radial ratio-response packet, with its calibration, covariance and comparison-domain error bounds, that can be transported to the TiAlV/PtRh mean-acceleration normalization without altering CLK002?
reentry: Only actual new owner data/uncertainty bytes or an exact source-audit correction; no unchanged-source rescan or automatic successor proof.
non_claims: No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, continuum, mass gap, TOE, empirical detection/exclusion, or microscopic geometry reconstruction. Completeness of the intake record is not completeness of the empirical evidence.
